messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert — metering pipeline anomaly detected in EU cluster: intermittent token_count dips and a flurry of overage flags for a small subset of customers. runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metering-stutter :rotating_light:

samir: I'm on it, acked. severity P2 for now. any immediate customer-visible spikes?

kira: seeing consumer lag on kafka group 'meter-processor-eu' and emitter retries looped. offsets stalled, inflight queue growing.

maria: can we pause emitter retries to stop potential duplicate increments while we investigate?

kira: yes — planning to scale emitter down for EU. issuing command now:
```
kubectl -n billing scale deployment metering-emitter-eu --replicas=0
```

kira: also kicking off a targeted replay for window 2026-03-16T22:00Z-23:00Z to reconcile counts after we quiet the pipeline.

devon: FYI support inbound — ~120 customers already received auto overage emails. Support queue shows ~6 tickets referencing overages.

ops_lead: temporary mitigation — suppress further auto-overage emails, notify CS, and mark affected accounts for manual review. tagging #cs-ops and #billing.

samir: oncall takeover acknowledged. I'll run replay job and enable `shadow_reconcile` flag so we can compare before committing. starting now.

incident-bot: oncall takeover by samir at 1714123460

kira: replay job started: job-id=rp-20260316-171412. sample logs:
```
[2026-03-16T22:12:05Z] INFO reconcile: processing customer=acme-corp window=22:12 offset=12456
[2026-03-16T22:12:07Z] WARN reconcile: duplicate-delta detected for token_batch=0x9f2
```

maria: emitter replicas scaled down. kafka consumer lag trending down, CPU on processing nodes recovering.

samir: replay found duplicate-delta pattern tied to emitter retry backoff miscalc. applying hotfix to hopper to dedupe on ingest. patch id ph-331.

kira: rolling hotfix to metering-hopper-eu: 
```
kubectl -n billing rollout restart deploy/metering-hopper-eu
```

devon: suppressed `billing.notify_overage` via feature flag flips to stop more emails. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Created support-issue S-7724 and linked impacted customers: acme-corp, beta-analytics, fintech-ops.

maria: reconciliation finished for the targeted window. deltas corrected, duplicate increments removed. No further overage flags emitted. We'll keep emitters paused for a 15m observation period.

samir: handing to oncall for monitoring window until 16:30 UTC. Owners for follow-up: kira (billing-eng) for root-cause & postmortem, devon for customer comms.

samir: next steps: write postmortem, update runbook to add emitter backoff threshold and automated pause on retry storm, consider customer credits if needed. cc @product-security.

kira: incident document created at https://redwood/incidents/1714123456 — will add timelines and logs.

samir: closing live mitigation. follow-up tasks assigned in tracker. :rotating_light:
